dev.reply:
Yes
As the backend developer, this rule is workable, unambiguous, and fair. Disallowing background lock watchers prevents silent races and file contention in the worktree while red or green cycles execute. Explicitly stopping a waiting seat and any spawned processes by process ID before taking over runs protects worktree integrity without disrupting unit commits, test doubles, or slice limits. It clarifies handoffs and eliminates accidental concurrent drivers cleanly without gaming.

CITE: Stop a waiting seat before its runs are taken over
